description: A principal must rule on a parent appeal concerning a challenged library book and finalize its access conditions, student guidance, and family-notice process, with input from the school librarian, school psychologist, and district compliance coordinator.

shared_context.S1: A parent has appealed the school's decision to keep a challenged book in the secondary library collection.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morgan has authority to issue the school's final ruling on the appeal.
shared_context.S3: The book is currently available to secondary students through ordinary library checkout.
shared_context.S4: The school's standard appeal procedure is for the principal to hear relevant observations from library, student-support, and compliance staff before issuing a ruling.

PF1.text: Ms. Shah verified the current grade 10 curriculum map and found that this title is the designated core text for a required unit; the library must keep it available for grade 10 instruction rather than remove it from the collection.

PF2.text: Dr. Ellis's student-support review found that the book's graphic material warrants a content advisory and staff-mediated checkout for students who choose to read it; she completed the review after a recent student-support meeting but has not entered the recommendation in the appeal file.

PF3.text: Mr. Brooks confirmed that the applicable district rule requires a parent or guardian opt-out process for this instructional title and written family notice within exactly 10 calendar days; he confirmed the rule with the district office this week but has not updated the school's appeal template.

acceptance_conditions: The book must remain in the collection because it is required for grade 10 instruction.
A content advisory must be provided.
A parent or guardian opt-out process must be provided.
Written family notice must be issued within exactly 10 calendar days.
A formal access-guidance commitment must be recorded.
A formal family-notice commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: ('keep' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'remain' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'retain' in decisions['collection_disposition']) and ('core text' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'grade 10' in decisions['collection_disposition'] or 'curriculum' in decisions['collection_disposition'])
content_checks.C3: decisions['content_advisory'] == True and 'staff-mediated checkout' in decisions['checkout_mode']
content_checks.C6: any('content advisory' in c['detail'] or 'staff-mediated checkout' in c['detail'] or 'appeal file' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('family notice' in c['detail'] or 'opt-out' in c['detail']) and '10 calendar days' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The curriculum map changes the ruling from possible removal to retaining the book because it is the designated core text for grade 10.
The student-support review changes access from ordinary checkout to a content advisory plus staff-mediated checkout and requires the access-guidance commitment.
The district rule changes the family process to parent opt-out, sets written notice at exactly 10 calendar days, and requires the family-notice commitment.
